Average-pools any [H,W,C] feature map to output_size x output_size.

torch.nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(output_size): output cell i averages input rows floor(i x H / s) .. ceil((i + 1) x H / s) - 1 (likewise columns), so any input size gives the same output size. Stays in the convolution section: Flatten or a global pool still ends it.

## Usage

```text
[H,W,C] -> [s,s,C], as torch.nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d(s): cell i averages rows floor(i*H/s) to ceil((i+1)*H/s) - 1 and the same columns; bins may overlap.
```

## Tips

- output_size 1 is a global average pool that keeps [1,1,C]; Flatten then gives C.
- Before Flatten it fixes the Dense input size: s x s x C.
